editorialProfile.tone: curious, grounded nature and conservation reporting
editorialProfile.defaultCustomRequest: Prepare a balanced, source-linked educational live feed about wildlife, ecology, oceans, biodiversity, climate, conservation and environmental research. Respect each source's permitted use exactly; educational/non-commercial purpose does not override item-level or third-party restrictions. Preserve original headlines and links where required. Do not store or display restricted summaries. Use independently verified documentary photographs only when exact source page, creator, credit, licence and contextual caption are confirmed. A headline/link without meaningful approved text or an independently approved relevant image is not publishable. Never invent or duplicate stories.

imagePolicy.optimization: Wikimedia Commons thumbnail up to 1600px; preserve attribution and ShareAlike notice
